title: Visual Instruction Tuning
authors: H. Liu, C. Li, Q. Wu, Y. Lee
before: Vision-language models came from large labs with large budgets.
problem: There was no open recipe for giving an open language model eyes.
breakthrough: A simple projection layer between CLIP and an open LLM, trained on visual instruction data generated by GPT-4.
why: It made open multimodal models buildable in a day, and set the template most open VLMs still use.
next: A wave of open vision-language models, and the multimodal expectations that followed.
